nikko-irohazaka-and-lake-chuzenji.title: Nikko · Irohazaka and Lake Chuzenji · 48 km from Nikkō
nikko-irohazaka-and-lake-chuzenji.slogan: A 48 km loop out of Irohazaka ascent
nikko-irohazaka-and-lake-chuzenji.story: Hairpins, cedar air and a famous ascent done respectfully. A 48 km loop that starts and ends near Nikkō, about 51 min of riding. It goes by way of Lake Chuzenji and Kegon Falls. Irohazaka ascent is the high point. It tops out at about 1,350 m. The passes are the reason to go.

legend-flores-trans-island-highway.slogan: Flores Trans Island Highway – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-flores-trans-island-highway.story: curated scenic road. volcanoes, rice fields, coast. A one-way ride of 272 km, Labuan Bajo to Maumere - roughly 4 h 57 in the saddle. On the way it passes Ruteng, Bajawa, Wolowaru and Detusoko. The highest point is about 900 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Trans-Flores Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 4 km this is Trans-Flores Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
